subject: Post-call recap: Vertex Health integration & SDK details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Simmons <aisha.simmons@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Vertex Health integration & SDK details

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and how Redwood could fit based on the call: 

Pain points you described:
- Sensitive PHI in queries + requirement to minimize data exposure (on-prem/VPC preferred).
- Current latency for real-time summarization is inconsistent (spiky during peak).
- Search/retrieval returns noisy results; need improved relevance and explainability.

Goals & success metrics you mentioned:
- Real-time visit summarization within 500ms avg token latency for clinician UI.
- Private data residency for PHI and options for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- 30-40% improvement in top-3 search relevance via reranking/embeddings.

Product fit notes (what we think is relevant):
- Streaming + function-calling: use streaming responses for the clinician UI and function-calling to return structured JSON summaries (patient_summary, action_items, confidence_score).
- Embeddings + reranking: embeddings store for clinical notes + reranking pipeline to boost relevance and surface citations.
- Private deployment: Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) + KMS support to satisfy PHI controls.
- SDKs: Python and TypeScript SDKs support streaming and function-calling; small client changes needed to adopt structured outputs.

Integration considerations we discussed:
- Auth: token-based with optional mTLS for private endpoints.
- KV cache and batching: we can tune batch windows to balance latency and cost; suggested initial batch size 8 for your request profile.
- Model variants: recommend quantized CPU model for draft/low-cost tasks, GPU model for low-latency summarization during peak hours.

Next steps / action items:
1) Marissa -> send SDK integration guide and security questionnaire (attached). Due: Mon 7/13.
2) Dev -> provide integration checklist and a short sample of function-calling payloads. Due: Tue 7/14.
3) Vertex -> confirm data residency and any procurement timelines; share signed security questionnaire if possible.
4) Rishi -> propose pilot pricing and suggested contract length (sales).

Attachments: redwood-sdk-integration-guide.pdf (PDF, 152KB)

If that all looks right, we can scope a 6-week pilot: 2 weeks integration/POC + 4 weeks evaluation. Happy to set a working session with Dev and your engineering team next week.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — adding a few technical notes to help the engs scope the integration: 

- SDK changes: the Python/TS SDK already exposes a streaming client and a function-calling helper. For your use case, we recommend the structured output schema (patient_summary -> {presenting_complaint, hpi, assessment, plan}). Minimal client work: register function schema + handler that maps Redwood response to your internal DTO.
- Function calling & validation: Redwood supports JSON Schema for function outputs; we can share example schemas so your team can validate at the edge.
- Streaming options: websocket-based streaming for web UI; gRPC streaming for backend-to-backend where low overhead is required.
- Privacy: for private deployments we support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) and audit logging. We can lock down logs to exclude full PHI by default and include token-level redaction hooks.

I attached a short integration checklist and a sample function schema. I'll be on standby to join a technical working session — suggest Tue 7/14 10am PT or Wed 7/15 9am PT.

Attachment: vertex_integration_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

Cheers,

- PII/PHI handling: we appreciate the redaction hooks. Can you share the exact fields that are logged by default and confirm an option to disable logging for protected fields?
- Pilot scope: we want a small POC that covers streaming summaries for 200 daily visits and a reranking test for a 50K-document index. That's our immediate priority.

Attached: vertex-security-questionnaire-signed.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB) — this includes the answers from our security team.
